definitions.calendar_candidate_enumeration: Every UTC Wednesday date from 2023-03-29 through 2024-12-25 inclusive, unchanged from V0.1.
definitions.accepted_contract: Exact archived metadata whose identity equals the candidate, kind=future, price_index=btcdvol_usdc, creation<expiration, expiration<2025-01-01 and listed life overlaps the bounded observation window.
definitions.ordinary_public_trade: A deduplicated exact-instrument historical trade with both block_trade_id and combo_id absent or null.
definitions.active_utc_day: UTC calendar date containing >=1 ordinary public trade inside observed_life.
definitions.qualifying_contract: Confirmed contract with >=20 ordinary public trades and >=5 unique active UTC days inside observed_life.
definitions.metadata_integrity_rate: Accepted exact contracts satisfying V0.2 metadata conditions divided by all exact metadata responses; nonexistent candidate misses excluded.

transport_rules.http_retries: Maximum 3 attempts for 429, 5xx or network exceptions with deterministic waits; exact instrument-not-found/wrong-format candidate misses are deterministic misses.
transport_rules.slice_rule: 24-hour bounded slices with count=1000 sorting=asc; recursively bisect exactly-1000 slices until below 1000 or <=1 second.
transport_rules.timestamp_firewall: Every retained trade must be within observed_life and strictly before 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z.
transport_rules.raw_payload_policy: Do not persist raw trade payloads; preserve request SHA-256, byte count, bounds and row count only.
transport_rules.economic_value_policy: Price, amount, direction, index_price and mark_price may only be inspected for field presence; no values are retained or summarized.

scientific_thresholds: Exactly those frozen in LIFECYCLE_SOURCE_AUTHORITY_V0.2.json; identical numerically to V0.1.
